item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over Guangdong tomorrow and it will be warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Saturday. Temperatures will fall appreciably and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon, it will be cold in the morning over Guangdong early next week. A dry replenishment of the monsoon will bring persistently cold and generally fine weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. One or two light rain patches and relatively low visibility in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
